subject: Coordinated MAP: MSA redlines, DPA gating, and order-form sequencing for PilotWave pilot
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@pilotwave.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: PilotWave Procurement <procure@pilotwave.io>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PilotWave pilot — MAP and timing

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We want to put together a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the 8-week pilot so procurement, legal, and engineering know the critical path. High level: legal wants MSA & DPA review first, procurement needs an approved PO before we go-live, and security will validate the DPA questionnaire during week 2–3.

Can you draft a MAP that shows sequencing (MSA redlines -> DPA -> PO -> onboarding) and a contingency if DPA review slides? Also please attach any standard PO/order form templates and call out acceptance criteria for the pilot.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Partnerships, PilotWave

Attachments: PilotWave_DPA_questionnaire.xlsx (filled), PilotWave_PO_template.pdf

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@pilotwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotWave pilot — MAP and timing

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Draft MAP attached and summarized below. I pulled in Karthik for legal sequencing and Marissa for acceptance gating and order-form details.

Summary MAP (draft):
- Week 0: Kickoff + exchange MSA/DPA redline PDFs
- Week 1–2: Legal review (MSA redlines) — parallel DPA questionnaire validation (security)
- Week 2: Agree on final MSA & sign, or identify 1–2 fallback clauses to bridge pilot
- Week 3: Procurement approves PO (procure issues PO) -> Redwood issues invoice for pilot kickoff
- Week 4–7: Pilot execution (success criteria: latency SLA, model quality evals, integration checks)
- Week 8: Pilot close, lessons, and decision to expand or terminate

Contingency options: temporary DPA scope addendum, or limit data residency to pseudonymized telemetry until DPA finalization.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_PilotWave_v1.pdf, Redwood_PO_template_for_pilot.pdf

Next steps: Karthik, can you confirm legal sequencing and whether we should propose a limited-scope DPA addendum as the fallback? Marissa, can you confirm the acceptance test owner and the PO flow?

— Avery
Avery Johnson
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@pilotwave.io>
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotWave pilot — MAP and timing

Tagged in. Quick notes from legal:
- We reviewed the MSA redlines you attached (PilotWave_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf). A few substantive items will need negotiation: liability cap language, data processing definitions, and termination-for-convenience notice. Expect 3–4 business days for initial comments.
- DPA: security team's questionnaire looks standard; to speed the pilot, propose a scoped DPA addendum (data types: telemetry logs + pseudonymized usage) to be signed before pilot execution. Full DPA can follow for production.
- Order form: we can accept the PO template, but procurement must include the pilot acceptance criteria (metric thresholds) in the PO line items so Finance can fast-track. If procurement requires an invoice-first model, we can offer a 30-day net invoice tied to a signed PO.

I'll attach editable redline suggestions and a short fallback addendum template.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

> On Fri, Mar 6, 2026 at 10:04 AM Avery Johnson wrote:
> > Draft MAP attached and summarized below...

From: Elena Morales <elena@pilotwave.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: PilotWave Procurement <procure@pilotwave.io>, Liam O'Connor <liam@pilotwave.io>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotWave pilot — MAP and timing

Karthik — appreciate the quick read. Procurement preference: PO before we begin but we can work with pilot-scoped addendum. Two items from our side:
1) Procurement will need the PO to reference the exact acceptance criteria and the line for the six-week pilot with the agreed price.
2) Legal would like the MSA cleared or a signed limited DPA addendum before any production data is processed. We can sign a scoped addendum for the pilot data types you described.

We attached our filled DPA questionnaire (PilotWave_DPA_questionnaire.xlsx). Liam from procurement is looping to indicate internal timing — we can route DocuSign once MSA redlines are narrowed.

DocuSign (procurement route): https://app.docusign.com/templates/abc123-pilotwave

Thanks — Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@pilotwave.io>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotWave pilot — MAP and timing

Hi all — quick ops notes from the acceptance and billing side:
- Acceptance owner: Marissa Cole (CS Operations) -> I will run the evaluation checklist during week 4. Please confirm an internal technical contact to validate integration.
- Acceptance criteria we propose to include in PO: average inference latency <= 250ms p95, end-to-end pipeline availability >= 99.5% over test window, and model-quality threshold A/B lift >= +5% on the provided benchmark set.
- Billing: we can accept a PO (see attached PilotWave_PO_template.pdf). If procurement needs an invoice up-front, we can invoice 50% at kickoff and 50% at completion; otherwise net-30 tied to PO is fine.

Attachments: PilotWave_PO_template.pdf

Marissa

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@pilotwave.io>, PilotWave Procurement <procure@pilotwave.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PilotWave pilot — MAP and timing

Thanks everyone — aligned on next steps:
- Karthik to send redline summary + fallback DPA addendum by Mon 3/15
- Elena/Liam to route PO referencing acceptance criteria via DocuSign link this week
- Marissa to confirm pilot integration contact (Elena: please share) and run acceptance checklist week 4
- Avery to update HubSpot (HS-498217) with MAP and set reminder for week 3 check-in

If we hit any blocker on DPA scope, we will use the limited addendum to unblock pilot start.

See you on the call next Tuesday if issues arise. — Avery

[End thread]
